# Fluxero

> Fluxero converts curtailed (wasted) renewable energy into green hydrogen at the source using Small Modular Hydrogen Plants (SMHPs), optimised by a physics-based digital twin. The technology is deployable worldwide.

Every year, grids curtail enormous amounts of clean wind, solar and hydro power because it cannot be used or transmitted in the moment. Fluxero captures that otherwise-wasted electricity on-site and converts it into green hydrogen, turning a grid liability into a delivered fuel.

## What Fluxero builds
- **Small Modular Hydrogen Plant (SMHP):** a self-contained on-site package — renewable energy source intake, electrolyser, and hydrogen storage with containerisation. The electrolyser is the heart of every SMHP, splitting water (H2O -> H2 + O2) using the captured electricity.
- **Digital twin:** a live, physics-based mirror of every real plant that optimises operations and forecasts hydrogen output, de-risks the process through simulation, and bridges software/AI to hardware for maximum output.

## Key facts
- Category: green/renewable hydrogen production from curtailed energy.
- Core product: Small Modular Hydrogen Plant (SMHP) — source + electrolyser + hydrogen storage on site.
- Differentiator: a physics-based digital twin that optimises, forecasts and de-risks production.
- Backed by / in partnership with: NVIDIA Inception, Barclays Eagle Labs, Google for Startups, Durham University.
- Website: https://fluxero.uk
